title: Approvals inbox: the search box finds nothing by record title, process label or requester name — it matches only stored machine names (flow:…, crm_…, ids)
body:
## What happens

In the approvals inbox (`/_console/apps/<app>/component/approvals/inbox`) the search box is labelled **"Search record, process, requester…"** (zh-Hans: 「搜索记录、流程、申请人…」). Typing any text that the list actually shows — a record title, a process label, a requester's name — answers an empty list ("0 / 0", "No requests"). The only text that finds anything is the stored machine names the user never sees: `flow:…` process names, `crm_…` object names, and raw ids.

Seen on `@objectstack/*` 18.6.0 (HotCRM 6.6.0, zh-CN UI, organization admin), and the code on `main` is the same.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Have a few approval requests in an organization (10 in my run: an opportunity, project budgets, a timesheet, a travel request, expense reports).
2. Open the approvals inbox, tab **All**.
3. The list shows, per row: the process label (e.g. 「出差申请审批」), the record title (e.g. `Polar Cargo – Replacement`, `Stark Medical Pilot Delivery · v2`, 「UI测试：拜访上海客户」), the object label (「商机」, 「项目预算」, 「出差申请」…) and the requester (`Dev Admin`).
4. Type each of the terms below into the search box (the page sends `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?q=<term>&limit=50&offset=0`).

| Term typed | What it is on screen | Rows returned |
|---|---|---|
| `Polar`, `Cargo` | part of a record title | 0 |
| `Stark`, `v2` | part of a record title | 0 |
| `上海`, `拜访`, `UI测试` | part of a record title | 0 |
| `Dev`, `Admin` | the requester's name | 0 |
| `出差`, `报销`, `追加预算`, `大额` | part of a process label | 0 |
| `商机` | an object label | 0 |
| `budget` | nothing shown; substring of `flow:project_budget_approval` / `crm_project_budget` | 3 |
| `expense` | nothing shown; substring of `flow:expense_report_approval` / `crm_expense_report` | 5 |
| `opportunity` | nothing shown; substring of `crm_opportunity` | 1 |
| `crm_` | nothing shown; object-name prefix | 10 (all) |

Adding the object filter does not change it: `?q=Polar&object=crm_opportunity` and `?q=上海&object=crm_expense_request` both answer 0, although the request's snapshot holds that text in `name`.

## Expected

The search finds a request by what its row shows, which is also what the placeholder promises: the record title, the process label and the requester's name, in the reader's language.

## Why

`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`, `buildRequestWhere` (about line 10539 on `main`):

```ts
const q = filter?.q?.trim();
if (q) {
  const arms: any[] = [
    { process_name: { $contains: q } },
    { object_name: { $contains: q } },
    { record_id: { $contains: q } },
    { submitter_id: { $contains: q } },
  ];
  if (await this.freeTextMayMatchSnapshot(filter?.object, context)) {
    arms.push({ payload_json: { $contains: q } });
  }
  f.$or = arms;
}
```

The four fixed arms are machine columns. What the row renders — `record_title`, `process_label`, `submitter_name`, `object_label` — is resolved at serve time and is not among the arms. The snapshot arm is the only one that could reach a title, and it did not match in the runs above either.

The UI side is `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` line 1820: `placeholder={tr('searchPlaceholder', 'Search record, process, requester…')}`.

## Impact

An approver with a long queue cannot find a request by the customer, the project or the person it concerns; the search box looks broken ("no requests") for every natural query. With more than one page of requests there is no other way to locate one, because the search is server-side.

## Not checked

- Whether the stored display columns that the display-label backfill writes (if any) could be searched directly, or whether the titles have to be matched through a join.
- Why the `payload_json` arm did not match with the object filter set for an organization admin.
